proofs.title: Gradient-descent baseline
proofs.statement: Smooth-convex GD objective-gap bound on the bundled quadratic.
proofs.note: Step=1/L; positive iterations only. This is not a universal numerical proof.

proofs.title: Nesterov-style acceleration (smooth FISTA)
proofs.reference: Beck--Teboulle (2009), fixed-L FISTA with g=0; Nesterov (1983) historical origin
proofs.statement: Smooth FISTA iterates satisfy the O(1/k^2) objective-gap bound on this quadratic.
proofs.note: Historical CLI slug retained; not a literal reproduction of the 1983 algorithm.

proofs.title: Polyak heavy-ball (empirical tail)
proofs.statement: Compare a finite tail contraction estimate with the spectral-radius prediction.
proofs.metric: relative error: observed tail ratio vs predicted rho
proofs.note: alpha=2.77778, beta=0.444444, rho=0.666667; 8% is an empirical tolerance, not a theorem constant. Last up to 20 ratios above error=1e-10 are used.

proofs.title: Conjugate gradient
proofs.statement: Positive-iteration A-norm errors satisfy the classical condition-number envelope.
proofs.note: kappa=10; k=0 excluded to avoid its fixed ratio of 0.5.

proofs.title: Frank-Wolfe
proofs.statement: Primal gaps satisfy the curvature-based envelope for k>=1.
proofs.note: C_f=2 for this simplex quadratic; exact linear minimization oracle.

proofs.title: Proximal point
proofs.statement: Successive Euclidean errors satisfy the strongly-convex resolvent contraction.
proofs.note: q=0.909091; exact quadratic linear solves, not a general inexact PPA experiment.

proofs.title: FISTA
proofs.statement: Composite objective gaps satisfy the O(1/k^2) bound on diagonal LASSO.
proofs.note: Exact soft-threshold optimum; stable gap evaluation avoids objective cancellation.

proofs.title: ISTA vs FISTA (observation)
proofs.statement: Compare final objective gaps at the same iteration budget on one fixture.
proofs.metric: FISTA final gap / ISTA final gap
proofs.note: Informational, not pass/fail: FISTA is not guaranteed to beat ISTA at every iteration.
